children: RNS Number : 7251S  Jangada Mines PLC  01 September 2026
Jangada Mines plc / EPIC: JAN.L / Market: AIM / Sector: Mining

Jangada Mines plc (AIM: JAN), a Brazil-focused natural resource development company, today announces that Nicholas von Schirnding has stepped down from his position as Non-Executive Director of the Company as of 1st September 2026.

Following the successful establishment of the Company's new strategic direction, focused primarily on the development of gold projects in Brazil, and the positive completion of its Stage 1 exploration at the Molly Gold Project ('Molly'), Nick has decided that this is an appropriate time to step down from the Board to focus on his other business interests.

Brian McMaster, Chairman of Jangada, said: "I would like to thank Nick for his significant contribution to Jangada over the years. As a valued member of the Board since the Company's inception, he has played an important role in its development and progress. With our strategic transition to gold now complete, supported by the recent positive results from Molly, Nick has decided that the time is right to focus on his other activities. He remains a supportive shareholder and a valued friend of the Company. I have greatly enjoyed working with him and, on behalf of the Board, wish him every success for the future."
For further information, please visit http://www.jangadamines.com, follow us on social media (LinkedIn and X: @Jangada Mines Plc or contact:

Jangada is a natural resource development company listed on AIM of the London Stock Exchange (AIM:JAN) with assets in Brazil. It is led by a team with deep industry, financial and in-country experience, and has a dual growth strategy to:

·    Advance its portfolio projects including its right to acquire 100% of the high-grade Molly Gold Project, its current 33.3% interest in the Paranaíta Gold Project and the 100%-owned Pitombeiras vanadium titanomagnetite Project; and
·    Utilise its proven in-country and geological expertise to identify/acquire additional projects that it can rapidly advance to build value for shareholders.
